cases.sentence: Лучше сухая корка с покоем и миром, чем ___, полный заколотого скота, а в нем вражда.
cases.translation: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
cases.explain: Дом is the direct object of the implied comparison verb, taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Мудрый слуга будет править беспутным ___ и получит долю наследства.
cases.translation: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame.
cases.explain: Сына is the direct object of the implied verb править (to rule over), taking the accusative case.

cases.translation: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker.
cases.explain: Создателя is the direct object of оскорбляет (reproaches/insults), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Внуки — венец ___, а отцы — гордость своих сыновей.
cases.translation: Children's children are the crown of old men.
cases.explain: The dative after венец (crown) shows the recipient or possessor.

cases.sentence: Прощающие оскорбления ищут ___, а напоминающие о нем отталкивает близкого друга.
cases.translation: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
cases.explain: Любовь is the direct object of ищут (seek), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Упрек сильнее воздействует на разумного, чем сто ударов на ___.
cases.translation: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
cases.explain: Глупца is the indirect object after the preposition на (upon), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Если человек воздает за добро ___, зло не покинет его дома.
cases.translation: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
cases.explain: Зло is the direct object of воздает (rewards/repays), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Друг любит во всякое время, и брат рожден разделить ___.
cases.translation: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
cases.explain: Беду is the direct object of разделить (to share), taking the accusative case.

reading.ru: Лучше сухая корка с покоем и миром, чем дом, полный заколотого скота, а в нем вражда.
reading.question: What is more valuable: peace or feasting with strife?
options: Peace and quietness with little food are better than abundance with conflict
A house full of feasting is always preferable
reading.correct: Peace and quietness with little food are better than abundance with conflict
reading.explain: The verse clearly states: Лучше сухая корка с покоем и миром, чем дом, полный заколотого скота, а в нем вражда — Better is a dry morsel with quietness than a house full of feasting with strife.

reading.ru: Внуки — венец старикам, а отцы — гордость своих сыновей.
reading.question: What do grandchildren represent to the elderly and children to fathers?
options: Grandchildren are a crown to the aged and children are the glory of fathers
Children bring shame to their fathers
reading.correct: Grandchildren are a crown to the aged and children are the glory of fathers
reading.explain: The text states: Внуки — венец старикам (Grandchildren are the crown of old men) and отцы — гордость своих сыновей (children are the glory of fathers).

reading.ru: Прощающие оскорбления ищут любви, а напоминающие о нем отталкивает близкого друга.
reading.question: What is the difference between forgiving insults and holding grudges?
options: Forgiving seeks love while bringing up old wrongs distances close friends
Both forgiving and reminding bring the same results
reading.correct: Forgiving seeks love while bringing up old wrongs distances close friends
reading.explain: The verse contrasts: Прощающие оскорбления ищут любви (those who forgive seek love) versus напоминающие о нем отталкивает близкого друга (he who brings up the matter separates best friends).

reading.ru: Упрек сильнее воздействует на разумного, чем сто ударов на глупца.
reading.question: How differently do the wise and foolish respond to correction?
options: A rebuke affects the wise more than a hundred lashes affect a fool
Fools respond better to rebuke than the wise
reading.correct: A rebuke affects the wise more than a hundred lashes affect a fool
reading.explain: The verse shows: Упрек сильнее воздействует на разумного (a rebuke enters deeper into one of understanding) versus сто ударов на глупца (than a hundred lashes into a fool).

reading.ru: Веселое сердце исцеляет, как лекарство, а подавленный дух иссушает кости.
reading.question: What are the health effects of a cheerful versus a crushed spirit?
options: A cheerful heart heals like medicine while despair dries up the bones
Both have the same effect on health
reading.correct: A cheerful heart heals like medicine while despair dries up the bones
reading.explain: The text states: Веселое сердце исцеляет, как лекарство (A cheerful heart makes good medicine) but подавленный дух иссушает кости (a crushed spirit dries up the bones).

reading.ru: Даже глупца, когда он молчит, мудрым сочтут, и когда он удерживает язык, рассудительным.
reading.question: When is a fool considered wise?
options: When he stays silent and keeps his tongue in check
reading.correct: When he stays silent and keeps his tongue in check
reading.explain: The verse states: Даже глупца, когда он молчит, мудрым сочтут (even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise) and когда он удерживает язык, рассудительным (when he shuts his lips, he is thought discerning).
